import json, subprocess, sys, time
def build(nd, n=96):
    edges = []
    node = 0; diamonds = 0; li=[0]
    def lab():
        li[0]+=1
        return ("e%03d"%li[0])[:8]
    while node+3 <= n-1 and diamonds < nd:
        a,b,c,d = node,node+1,node+2,node+3
        edges.append({"u":a,"v":b,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":lab()})
        edges.append({"u":a,"v":c,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":lab()})
        edges.append({"u":b,"v":d,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":lab()})
        edges.append({"u":c,"v":d,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":lab()})
        node=d; diamonds+=1
    while node+1 < n:
        edges.append({"u":node,"v":node+1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":lab()})
        node+=1
    rounds=[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":1000000,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]
    return {"version":1,"n":n,"capacity":[48]*n,"edges":edges,"rounds":rounds}

for nd in (13, 14, 20):
    doc = build(nd)
    json.dump(doc, open('b.json','w'))
    t0=time.time()
    with open('b.json','rb') as f:
        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'], stdin=f, capture_output=True)
    t1=time.time()
    if p.returncode == 2:
        print(nd, "diamonds:", "invalid-input", "%.2fs"%(t1-t0))
    else:
        out=json.loads(p.stdout)
        print(nd, "diamonds:", "valid, paths=", out["summary"]["topology_paths"], "%.2fs"%(t1-t0))
EOF
